verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing directly claims unlimited environments so everyone can ship at once, and it adds per-pull-request previews and environment management through its MCP server. However, the evidence is only homepage taglines, and isolation between environments is never documented. Missing for 10: documentation that environments are isolated (separate services, data and variables per environment), in-depth docs on how environments are created and managed, and independent or hands-on corroboration that unlimited parallel environments work for teams.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up unlimited isolated environments so my whole team can ship simultaneously

citations.quote: Unlimited environments mean everyone can ship simultaneously.
Every pull request gets its own preview.
